prompt: 干場社長からCOW受付、担当セル、制作・検品、社長確認までの指示経路を一画面で可視化し、スマホ・PC向けの簡潔な指示テンプレートを提供

autonomous_flow.note: One instruction automatically drives naming, genre selection, planning, generation, validation and repair.

easy_mode.note: The human only plays the completed candidate and submits a review or publication approval.

review_loop.note: Reviews are versioned, but arbitrary functional changes still require a supported generator path.

puzzle_game.note: Game generation produces a playable 6x8 match puzzle with combo resolution, special pieces, stages, achievements and persistent high scores.

embedded_media.note: Gem art is embedded SVG and music plus effects are synthesized with Web Audio; no external asset request is required.

launcher_icon.note: CG free-operation and archive launchers use a dedicated COW mark and CODEXWorld label instead of the cow character.

mobile_freshness.note: Navigation requests bypass HTTP cache, service worker updates bypass cache, and the PWA start URL carries the current build id.

root_entry_sync.note: Both the repository root PWA entry and latest entry expose the COW launcher and COW library launcher.

job_visibility.note: Each request receives a visible job id, receipt time, five-stage progress bar and timestamped activity log.

cell_production.note: Every request is assigned to one accountable specialist agent who owns planning, production, inspection and delivery.

office_ledger.note: The office dashboard retains job owner, due time, systems, quality plan, progress and deliverable links.

horror_game.note: Horror requests produce a dedicated exploration game with embedded scenes, synthesized audio, save data and three endings, validated by requirement-specific gates.

project_retention.note: Completed candidates and recoverable legacy candidates are retained in a local project history before CG publication.

resume.note: An interrupted received, planning, generating or testing job resumes after reload.

free_operation.note: Runtime uses browser-local rules and templates without model API calls.

cg_publication.note: Approved artifacts appear in the CG COW content area in the same browser.

archive.note: Artifacts are grouped by genre and exported as folder-structured ZIP bundles.

command_chain.note: 干場社長からCOW受付、担当セル、制作・検品、社長確認までを現在の仕事に連動して表示する。

compact_prompt.note: スマホとPCの一画面整理に必要な区分、上限、操作寸法、未確認表示、実機検査を含む指示例を一クリックで入力する。

mobile_visual.note: 320px相当の実ブラウザー表示で縦型の指示経路とテンプレート入力を確認した。
